# Typed same owner constructor delegation

Both original constructors declare the same Config<T> input in the owner's
scope. The wider entry calls the primary constructor before writing its float
bias. Frozen callers verify every original constructor Signature, config
identity, primary/default NaN state, raw float bits, nulls and partial fields at
ordered failures. Every original entry, field and metadata is audited. Four
independently compiled wrong programs must fail in owned and declaration modes.
